commits.subject: Merge main while preserving package-wide telemetry checks
Merge main while preserving package-wide telemetry checks

report.scope: Structural/Git verification only. No target code or tests are executed.

metadata.body:
Run one Weaver live check per package while the runner captures raw OTLP in a separate window for each scenario. Scenario assertions use those captures, and Weaver reports package-wide semantic convention violations.

HTTP packages now point to an independent client or server contract:

```yaml
# client
scenario_contract: ../../../../../../tools/http/contracts/client.yaml
scenario_run: node scenario.js

# server
scenario_contract: ../../../../../../tools/http/contracts/server.yaml
scenario_run: otel-http-drive --serve node ../server.js
```

A contract's `driver` sets the process lifecycle. `instrumentation` runs one process per action. `runner` keeps one measured server alive and drives its actions in order through the `jsonl-v1` protocol. Language helpers receive runner-selected actions as JSON instead of reading YAML.

`expected_violations` now belongs at package level, where it reconciles with the aggregate Weaver report. Each pytest package item owns the full lifecycle, and diagnostic output contains per-scenario capture reports plus one aggregate Weaver report.
metadata.title: Run one Weaver check per package with isolated OTLP capture
